questions.question: Define wellness.Explain its main dimensions. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Define wellness. Explain its main dimensions. [K] [CO1]
  • Answer: Definition -1 mark, any four dimensions-2 narks
  • Wellness is the state of complete physical, mental, and social well-being, not merely the
  • absence of disease.
  • Main dimensions include:
  • • Physical wellness: Maintaining a healthy body through exercise, nutrition, and sleep.
  • • Mental/Emotional wellness: Ability to cope with stress and maintain positive
  • thinking.
  • • Social wellness: Maintaining healthy relationships and social interactions.
  • • Intellectual
  • • Spiritual
  • • Occupational
  • • Cultural
  • • Financial
